From Stray Cat · Price: it needs sunlight.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 1 action in sunlight: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible} air bubble, range 30 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] (attack roll); the target doesn't see where it came from.
  • 5: Bubbles can wait in place as traps for 1 minute.
  • 9: Surge: an air bubble wall gives an ally +2 circumstance AC against ranged attacks for 1 round.
  • 13: Surge: 3 bubbles at different targets, each @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]].
  • 17: Reaction, once per round: a bubble shield gives you or an adjacent ally +2 circumstance AC against one ranged attack.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.Rz8Qs0WXOBj6MTEn]{Effect: Air Bubble Wall}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
